items.title: Whole Flowering Sunflower
items.alt: Whole flowering sunflower with a golden head, broad toothed leaves, a rough stem and a small exposed root base.
items.description: Whole flowering sunflower with a golden head, broad toothed leaves, a rough stem and a small exposed root base. Use the complete plant in a classroom plant-parts activity or a personal garden journal.

items.title: Sunflower Head Study
items.alt: Front-facing sunflower head with golden ray petals and a detailed dark central disc.
items.description: Front-facing sunflower head with golden ray petals and a detailed dark central disc. This isolated head suits a classroom flower-structure card or a personal floral design.

items.title: Back of a Sunflower
items.alt: Back of a sunflower head with overlapping pointed green bracts, a short stem and a side leaf.
items.description: Back of a sunflower head with overlapping pointed green bracts, a short stem and a side leaf. Use the less familiar rear view in a classroom observation task or a botanical journal.

items.title: Opening Sunflower Bud
items.alt: Opening sunflower bud with spreading green bracts, folded golden petals and a young green central disc.
items.description: Opening sunflower bud with spreading green bracts, folded golden petals and a young green central disc. Place the bud in a classroom growing sequence or a personal nature journal.

items.title: Sunflower Seedling in a Pot
items.alt: Young sunflower seedling with oval seed leaves and toothed true leaves in a weathered terracotta pot.
items.description: Young sunflower seedling with oval seed leaves and toothed true leaves in a weathered terracotta pot. Use the potted seedling in a classroom planting activity or a personal growing checklist.

items.title: Germinating Sunflower Seed
items.alt: Split striped sunflower hull surrounding a pale seed with a green shoot and fine white roots.
items.description: Split striped sunflower hull surrounding a pale seed with a green shoot and fine white roots. The enlarged germinating seed suits a classroom life-cycle card or an observation worksheet.
